feature: A long edit plays, scrubs and edits without a stutter (pass 10)
summary: An edit on the 6 minute edit now redraws only the clips it changed instead of every clip in sight, and picking a clip no longer redraws every clip either. Worst of three runs while it plays: a trim on a picked clip 24 to 18 ms, a cut on a picked clip 46 to 26, an undo 36 to 27, a cut with nothing picked 89 to 62. Nothing on screen looks different.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the 6 minute reference edit (Scripts/perf/reference-edit.sh 6).

try.do: Press Space to play the edit.
While it plays, drag the end of a clip just ahead of the playhead half a second shorter.
Click a clip on V1, then click a different one.
Press B on the picked clip, then Command Z.
Pick a clip, set its Speed to 2x, and check the ruler still leaves room for its Source lane.

evaluate: Does a trim while it plays land without the picture catching?
Does picking one clip after another feel instant?
Do the clips either side of a trimmed clip still show their cut correctly, one frame after the picture at most?
rough: Bars still not reached, so this task stays open.
